ayahs.ar: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
ayahs.en: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two]
ayahs.e2: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺
ayahs.tr: Iqtarabatis Saa'atu wsan shaqqal qamar

ayahs.ar: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةࣰ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرࣱ مُّسۡتَمِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.en: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic
ayahs.e2: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”
ayahs.tr: Wa iny yaraw aayatany yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrum mustamirr

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرࣲ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.en: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement
ayahs.e2: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—
ayahs.tr: Wa kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; wa kullu amrim mustaqirr

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
ayahs.en: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence
ayahs.e2: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad jaaa'ahum minal ambaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar

ayahs.ar: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةࣱۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.en: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them]
ayahs.e2: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺
ayahs.tr: Hikmatum baalighatun famaa tughnin nuzur

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءࣲ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.en: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding
ayahs.e2: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying
ayahs.tr: Fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai 'in nukur

ayahs.ar: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادࣱ مُّنتَشِرࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading
ayahs.e2: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts
ayahs.tr: khushsha'an absaaruhum yakrujoona minal ajdaasi ka annahum jaraadum muntashir

ayahs.ar: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day
ayahs.e2: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”
ayahs.tr: Muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir

ayahs.ar: ۞كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونࣱ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
ayahs.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled
ayahs.e2: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated
ayahs.tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoo nunw wazdujir

ayahs.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبࣱ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
ayahs.en: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help
ayahs.e2: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”
ayahs.tr: Fada'aa Rabbahooo annee maghloobun fantasir

ayahs.ar: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءࣲ مُّنۡهَمِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
ayahs.e2: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain
ayahs.tr: Fafatahnaaa abwaabas sa maaa'i bimaa'im munhamir

ayahs.ar: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونࣰ ا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣲ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
ayahs.en: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined
ayahs.e2: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set
ayahs.tr: Wa fajjamal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir

ayahs.ar: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحࣲ وَدُسُرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails
ayahs.e2: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails
ayahs.tr: Wa hamalnaahu 'alaa zaati alwaahinw wa dusur

ayahs.ar: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءࣰ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.en: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied
ayahs.e2: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied
ayahs.tr: Tajree bi a'yuninaa jazaaa 'al liman kaana kufir

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةࣰ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.e2: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa laqat taraknaahaad aayatan fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning
ayahs.e2: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
ayahs.tr: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.e2: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mimmuddakir

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادࣱ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.en: Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning
ayahs.e2: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
ayahs.tr: Kazzabat 'Aadun fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحࣰ ا صَرۡصَرࣰ ا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسࣲ مُّسۡتَمِرࣲّ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery
ayahs.tr: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee Yawmi nahsim mustamirr

ayahs.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلࣲ مُّنقَعِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted
ayahs.e2: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees
ayahs.tr: Tanzi;un naasa ka anna huma'jaazu nakhlim munqa'ir

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning
ayahs.e2: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
ayahs.tr: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.e2: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.en: Thamud denied the warning
ayahs.e2: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺
ayahs.tr: Kazzabat Samoodu binnuzur

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرࣰ ا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدࣰ ا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.en: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness
ayahs.e2: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane
ayahs.tr: Faqaalooo a-basharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw wa su'ur

ayahs.ar: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar
ayahs.e2: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”
ayahs.tr: A-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi mim baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir

ayahs.ar: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدࣰ ا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
ayahs.en: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar
ayahs.e2: ˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is
ayahs.tr: Sa-ya'lamoona ghadam manil kazzaabul ashir

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةࣰ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient
ayahs.e2: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience
ayahs.tr: Innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir

ayahs.ar: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبࣲ مُّحۡتَضَرࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn]
ayahs.e2: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”
ayahs.tr: Wa nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatum bainahum kullu shirbim muhtadar

ayahs.ar: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.en: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]
ayahs.e2: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺
ayahs.tr: Fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa'aqar

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning
ayahs.e2: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
ayahs.tr: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders
ayahs.tr: Innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaano kahasheemil muhtazir

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.e2: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.en: The people of Lot denied the warning
ayahs.e2: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings
ayahs.tr: Kazzabat qawmu lootim binnuzur

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطࣲۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
ayahs.e2: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn
ayahs.tr: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala Loot najjainaahum bisahar

ayahs.ar: نِّعۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.en: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful
ayahs.e2: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks
ayahs.tr: Ni'matam min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.en: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning
ayahs.e2: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad anzarahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw binnuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.en: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning
ayahs.e2: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad raawadoohu 'andaifee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابࣱ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.en: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment
ayahs.e2: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan 'azaabum mustaqirr

ayahs.ar: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.en: So taste My punishment and warning
ayahs.e2: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”
ayahs.tr: Fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.e2: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad yassarnal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.en: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning
ayahs.e2: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad jaaa'a Aala Fir'awnan nuzur

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
ayahs.en: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability
ayahs.e2: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful
ayahs.tr: Kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa kullihaa fa akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir

ayahs.ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةࣱ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.en: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture
ayahs.e2: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books
ayahs.tr: Akuffaarukum khairum min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz Zubur

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعࣱ مُّنتَصِرࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]
ayahs.e2: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”
ayahs.tr: Am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'um muntasir

ayahs.ar: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.en: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat]
ayahs.e2: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee
ayahs.tr: Sa yuhzamul jam'u wa yuwalloonad dubur

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.en: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter
ayahs.e2: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter
ayahs.tr: Balis Saa'atu maw'iduhum was Saa'atu adhaa wa amarr

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes
ayahs.tr: Innal mujrimeena fee dalaalinw wa su'ur

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.en: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar
ayahs.e2: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”
ayahs.tr: Yawma yushaboona fin Naari'alaa wujoohimim zooqoo massa saqar

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, all things We created with predestination
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained
ayahs.tr: Innaa kulla shai'in khalaqnaahu biqadar

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةࣱ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
ayahs.en: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye
ayahs.e2: Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye
ayahs.tr: Wa maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bilbasar

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.e2: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءࣲ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.en: And everything they did is in written records
ayahs.e2: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records
ayahs.tr: Wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz Zubur

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرࣲ وَكَبِيرࣲ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
ayahs.en: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed
ayahs.e2: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺
ayahs.tr: Wa kullu sagheerinw wa kabeerim mustatar

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَهَرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers
ayahs.tr: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa nahar

ayahs.ar: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
ayahs.en: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability
ayahs.e2: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign
ayahs.tr: Fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda Maleekim Muqtadir
